WITH rating_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price
  FROM rating_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(rm.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
  AVG(rm.daily_price) AS avg_daily_price,
  AVG(rm.daily_price - cra.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price
FROM rating_metrics AS rm
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_avg AS cra
WHERE rm.daily_price > cra.avg_daily_price

assumptions.assumption: Each rating is weighted equally in the cross-rating average and in the final averages, as requested by taking a simple average across ratings.
